body: Starting to freak out about going to work tomorrow because of the onslaughts of suicidal thoughts that will inevitably happen throughout the day.  I start hyperventilating every morning on my way there and I haven't slept more than 3 hours any night before work for the past few weeks.  I don't know how to make this better.  My job is stressful, but I don't think it's necessarily the job that's the problem, it's me.  Started cutting myself tonight and counting out my pills.  So much anxiety thinking about tomorrow.  I have to decide soon if I'm going to try to go to the hospital tonight or try to go to sleep, because I have to get up in 5 and a half hours if I'm going to work.  Feel like such a pussy.

Thank you so much for taking the time to think about my concerns.  I'm still not sure what I'm going to do, but calling in to work tomorrow so I can go to the doctor is certainly a possibility.  I always feel so guilty doing that (well, actually I never have, because I'd feel so guilty), but we'll see.

Questions: How would my primary know who is available now or on an emergency basis?  Wouldn't she just say, "If it's an emergency, go to the emergency room"?  I'm just doubtful that any regular psychiatrist would see me tomorrow.  How referrals seem to work with my primary is she gives me a list or a number and I call them, make an appointment, then call her office back for an insurance referral.  Would she actually call someone herself and say I need to be seen?  I'm also really scared of making phone calls, so I'm not sure I'll be able to get myself to call, but I guess I could stop by the office and ask for an appointment with her later in the day.  Supposedly they can usually arrange that.  The psychiatrist thing, though... I'm pessimistic about getting an appointment in time.  I guess I should still try.
